relationships.description: Money transfer from one account to another

expected_shape: list of owner IDs sorted ascending
assumptions: Account numbers are stored as string or integer attribute
Owner IDs are numeric and comparable
Each account has exactly one owner
uncertainties: Direction of SENT_MONEY may be reversed in data
Multiple owners per account may exist
acceptance_tests: Query returns owners of accounts that account 108 has sent money to
Result contains exactly five lowest owner IDs in ascending order
Result is empty if no transfers from account 108

decisions.initial_cypher: MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN DISTINCT target.owner_id AS owner_id ORDER BY owner_id ASC LIMIT $limit

verify_decision.revision: MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})<-[:OWNS]-(owner:Owner {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN DISTINCT owner.owner_id AS owner_id ORDER BY owner_id ASC LIMIT 5

executions.cypher: MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN DISTINCT target.owner_id AS owner_id ORDER BY owner_id ASC LIMIT $limit
